Check customer ownership on every request. Staff MFA and restricted permissions. Least-privilege DB roles, audited refunds, exact money, unique keys and atomic stock/payment transitions.
S3 stores media, PDFs and large payloads; PostgreSQL stores searchable metadata and object references. JSONB supplements typed tables.
